## LLM012 New AiServices per request

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | error |
| Framework | LangChain4j |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://github.com/pgy763/llm-lint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#llm012 |
| Turn it off | `LLM012: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM012` on the command line |

AiServices.create(...) binds memory, ContentRetriever and tools onto the generated proxy. Put in a business method, that means fresh memory per request — what was said in the last turn is forgotten in the next, and retrievers and tools are reassembled too. The proxy itself is thread-safe; build it once.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM012` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm012 -->

## What it looks like

`AiServices.create(...)` called per request.

## How to fix

Create the `AiServices` proxy once — it is thread-safe — and inject it.
